typography.evidence: Archivo 700 stretch 112% for display and IBM Plex Sans 400/600 for body. Audit sizes 12.5/14.4/16/18/20/24/38.4/44px; body 16px/1.65; h1 44px tracking -0.025em; p max-width 62ch; long_line_count 0. Mobile h1 33.6px. Contact h2 is now Quote LABSA 90% from Gundlav. Scale leaks (8 sizes, h3 = lead) keep this below 9.
strengths: Archivo 112% stretch vs IBM Plex Sans is a deliberate industrial pair.
Body 16px/1.65, 62ch measure, h1 44px with tight tracking, tabular-nums on spec figures.
Hero locked to two lines; plant/sales phones set as Archivo numerals with tracked labels.

issues.where: table.spec th on index.html #spec and labsa-90.html
issues.problem: 50/50 columns wrap labels as (% by / weight) and values as alkyl / benzene.
issues.fix: Set table.spec to table-layout:fixed with col 13.5rem 1fr. Put a br before each (% by weight) unit.

issues.problem: h3 is 18px, the same size as lead. Eight sizes vs the 5-7 step scale.
issues.fix: Set h3 to 1.25rem (20px). Restyle .reach h3 to 0.78125rem uppercase. Set figcaption to .78125rem.

issues.problem: Raw materials and product tanks leaves the widow tanks.
issues.fix: Add text-wrap:balance on h1,h2 and a br after Raw materials.

issues.problem: Private Limited wraps so Limited sits alone.
issues.fix: Use Private Limited so the legal suffix stays together.
